claim_en: THE BLEMISH CENSUS ON TWELVE CLASS HEADS, THREE TOKENS SHARED WITH THE ANIMAL'S. Twelve heads in the ink's order; 'blemish' five times against three; the block written four times; Bekhorot 7 whole graded on the heads' Sifra members; the two lists share exactly garav, yalefet, sarua and the cross-list transfer runs on the first two by name; the difference table with opposite signs; the blemished eats; served invalid. Filed F-227, auto-seated (sitting L5).
middah: ink (the blemish census on twelve class heads in the ink's order; 'blemish' five times against three; the block written four times; the two lists share exactly three tokens and the transfer runs on two by name, I2, beside; Bekhorot 7 whole)
